faqs.question: Can I visit the construction site at any time?
faqs.answer: For safety reasons, site visits must be scheduled in advance with your Site Supervisor. Unaccompanied access is strictly prohibited.

faqs.question: When are progress payments due?
faqs.answer: Progress payments are due at the completion of each major stage (Slab, Frame, Lockup, Fixing, Practical Completion). Invoices are sent via the Customer Portal and are payable within 7 business days.

faqs.question: What is covered under the post-handover warranty?
faqs.answer: We provide a 3-month minor defects warranty period and a statutory 6-year structural guarantee. Warranty requests can be logged directly through the Warranty page in the Customer Portal.

faqs.question: How will I be notified of weather delays?
faqs.answer: Any weather or material delay is recorded in our Site Diary and will automatically show up on your timeline and dashboard. Your supervisor will log estimated delays as they occur.

guardrails: Prioritize safety instructions in all site visit inquiries.
Direct complex contract and payment variations to the company manager.
Always suggest contacting supervisor Eric for lot-specific timeline details.
